title: ee.daemon.start.v1
description: The data object in the ee.response.v2 envelope from ee daemon start. Foreground mode binds the workspace endpoint and waits for termination. Detached mode starts a foreground child and reports success only after its endpoint becomes reachable. Each workspace daemon owns its model memory; no daemon is required for ordinary CLI operation.

socketPath.description: Absolute bound workspace endpoint: `${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/ee/d-<workspace-hash>.sock`, or the private per-UID `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ee-${uid}/d-<workspace-hash>.sock` fallback. Long runtime paths use /tmp/ee-${uid} to preserve socket length headroom. The hash uses the canonical workspace path. Override with --socket. Unix-only; the parent must be private and owned by the current UID.

foreground.description: Echo of the `--foreground` flag. When `true` the CLI process blocks after emitting this envelope and the accept loop runs in the same process; when `false` the handle is leaked so the accept thread outlives the call but the parent CLI process returns. The bd-37o8k follow-up replaces the detached path with a real daemonize step (fork + setsid) and a readiness probe.
